nodes.title:
Call recordings play from short-lived signed links to the voice runtime: GET /v1/recordings/{callId}?ws&exp&sig, sig = HMAC-SHA256(VP_RUNTIME_SECRET, 'vp-recording.v1
' + callId + '
' + workspaceId + '
' + exp). call.get returns recording {url, expiresAt, why}: a 10-minute link on VP_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_URL (else VP_RUNTIME_URL) when the call has a recording, it is inside the workspace's recordings retention (policy.retention.get recordings_days) and no erase_me request exists for the person. The runtime refuses expired links, links living over an hour, forged signatures and a workspace other than the one in the .json beside each .wav; call ids are UUID-validated, never joined raw; no listing; aiohttp FileResponse serves Range
nodes.rationale: Web's ee8aef6 found recordingUri is a file path on the voice server, so no real recording could play. A link tied to one workspace and ten minutes leaks little if copied; the browser's <audio> needs no CORS. There is no per-workspace recording switch to respect beyond the agent's own recording setting (the runtime records only when it is on and the caller did not refuse); retention is enforced at play time only, nothing deletes runtime files yet.
nodes.reverse_if: Recordings move to object storage (then sign storage URLs instead), or a per-workspace recording policy is added (then call.get must check it too).

nodes.title: Nothing deletes recording files on the voice runtime when recordings_days passes or a person asks to be erased: the control plane only stops signing links. A purge needs a signed runtime route (or storage lifecycle) driven by calls' retention and forget_request.
nodes.closes_when: A runtime purge route (or a storage lifecycle) deletes recording files past recordings_days and on an erase request, with a test that the file is gone and its link refused.

nodes.title: The outcome rule is a table of PERSON shapes mapped to the VALUE that names them: agrees -> agreeing; refuses -> refusing; not the person called -> wrong-person, never null; complains AND asks for a human -> needs-human, never null; asks never to be called again -> refusing, never call-later; asks to be called later -> call-later; null only for no shape, a language they cannot follow, a hang-up before the question, or distress. And tiered never escalates when the first pass names a NO_DECISION reason (CONV_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH)
nodes.rationale: Answers rejected.2026-10-23.analysis-stance-rule-mini-false-nulls (mini returned null on wrong-person and complaint-to-human calls and called an opt-out a callback) and rejected.2026-10-23.tiered-escalates-no-decision-model-codes (6 of 12 escalations were language-mismatch calls whose outcome code discards). Written from the DEV patterns the integrator reported; TEST not consulted. Not measured on a real model here.
nodes.reverse_if: The DEV gate or the two TEST passes show mini or tiered losing calls to the new table versus round 3.

nodes.title: A refusal caused by server setup is plain words plus a code (SetupError: telephony_disabled, secret_key_missing, runtime_not_configured); the operator's hint (the variable to set) goes to the server log once. The registry passes the code on in not_executed, and every receipt from execute/approve passes a backstop: a reason that names an env var, a server path or a stack frame is logged and replaced with plain words
nodes.rationale: Answers rejected.2026-10-24.telephony-disabled-env-var-in-refusal: web hid the text but API and MCP callers still read it. The LLM door's 'no model configured' message no longer names variables either. tests/no-server-detail.test.ts runs every registered tool as an owner with the setup missing and fails if any refusal or result carries server detail, or if the backstop had to catch one; on the old code it failed (3 of 4 tests).
nodes.reverse_if: An operator-facing API needs the hint; then add it behind an operator role, never in a member's receipt.

nodes.title: In the campaign, audience, contact and offering namespaces a bare id (input, else a create's result) is the activity subject before any other key, so campaign.draft is about the campaign it saved and campaign.launch/pause/stop get a subject at all. Proposal rows carry the proposed tool (activity.list item.tool) and the web sentence names that action and its subject; without it, the line's own words, never 'a change'
nodes.reverse_if: Another namespace's bare id names something other than its own entity.

nodes.title: call.search and call.get return agent {id, name, version, label: 'Asha, version 3'} from one LEFT JOIN on agent_version and agent (the agent's workspace must be the call's); null for a draft test call. The query count of call.search is the same for 2 calls and 20 (tested by counting client queries)
nodes.rationale: Answers open.2026-10-24.call-log-agent-version (R11, must-be 13). The web call log can show it; the column itself is web's.
nodes.reverse_if: agent_version gains workspace_id; then join on it directly.
